svg.title: Overhead
svg.desc: App icon for Overhead: a worm's-eye view up a canyon between two buildings, their verticals converging to a vanishing point above the canvas (512, -700), with one aircraft crossing the open sky. Reads at 48 px from three shapes only - two dark masses, the slot of sky between them, and the magenta aircraft. Safe area: all identifying content sits inside the centred circle r 410 (80% of the canvas) and clear of the corners, so round and rounded-square masks both crop only the bleeding building flanks. Full-bleed background - no transparent margin. Palette: sky #c9d6dc, near massing #1d2e44, held-back block #3e5772, aircraft #b0246e.
